checks.title: Run a real Presentation-mode walkthrough
checks.instruction: After all automated and trace QA is green, run a short real presentation with ambient speech, one deictic visual command, one knowledge question, one background-prepared resource and one mode exit. Confirm Jarvis stays quiet when not addressed, responds immediately when addressed, visual commands avoid filler speech, and SIMPLE behavior returns after exit. Also confirm the two PRESENTATION-specific behaviours: while a session is live, the manual key arms an address window for the next sentence and does not stop the session (stop it by speaking over Jarvis or saying "Jarvis mute"); and a pending confirmation is answered with "Jarvis, oui" or a key press followed by "oui", since a bare "oui" is treated as room speech.
